**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a summer bike trip with friends.  
[EVENT] User volunteered at a charity bike ride event on May 6th.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on volunteering at the charity bike ride event and expressed excitement for the user's trip.  
[FACT] User is looking for bike trails in the Midwest, specifically in Wisconsin or Michigan.  
[PREFERENCE] User and friends are comfortable with a mix of paved paths and dirt trails.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for trails with scenic views and rest stops.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recommendations for bike trails in Wisconsin and Michigan, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Elroy-Sparta State Trail (Wisconsin) - 32 miles, mix of paved and crushed stone surfaces, scenic views, several rest stops.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wiouwash State Trail (Wisconsin) - 22 miles, mostly paved, scenic views of the Fox River Valley.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lake Wissota State Park Trails (Wisconsin) - 20 miles of trails, including a 6-mile trail around the lake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Blue Mounds State Park Trails (Wisconsin) - 15 miles of trails, including a 4-mile trail through prairies and forests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Pere Marquette State Trail (Michigan) - 30 miles, paved, scenic views of the Pere Marquette River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Leelanau Trail (Michigan) - 17 miles, mix of paved and crushed stone, scenic views of the Leelanau Peninsula.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Sleeping Bear Heritage Trail (Michigan) - 27 miles, paved, stunning views of the lakeshore.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. North Country Trail (Michigan) - 460 miles, mix of paved and dirt trails, scenic views of forests, lakes, and rivers.  
[FACT] User expressed interest in the Elroy-Sparta State Trail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details about the Elroy-Sparta State Trail, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Length: 32 miles, mix of paved (10 miles) and crushed stone (22 miles).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Relatively flat with gentle hills, suitable for road bikes and hybrid bikes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Scenic views of wooded areas, prairies, wetlands, and a historic trestle bridge over the Baraboo River.
